act.name: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
act.source_authority: Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law providing free legal services and establishing Legal Services Authorities and Lok Adalats.

sections.title: Criteria for giving legal services.
sections.text: Section 12 identifies categories of persons entitled to legal services under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Lists who may qualify for free legal aid, including specified vulnerable groups and eligible low-income persons.
keywords: woman child SC ST disability custody income

sections.title: Entitlement of legal services.
sections.text: Section 13 governs entitlement to legal services for persons satisfying the Act's criteria and prima-facie requirements.
sections.plain_language_summary: A qualifying person may receive legal services when the statutory entitlement conditions are met.

sections.title: Organisation of Lok Adalats.
sections.text: Section 19 provides for organization of Lok Adalats by Legal Services Authorities and Committees.
sections.plain_language_summary: Legal Services bodies may organize Lok Adalats for settlement of suitable disputes.

sections.title: Cognizance of cases by Lok Adalats.
sections.text: Section 20 governs the kinds of pending and pre-litigation disputes that a Lok Adalat may take up and its settlement process.
sections.plain_language_summary: Suitable pending cases or pre-litigation disputes may be referred to Lok Adalat for an agreed settlement.

sections.title: Award of Lok Adalat.
sections.text: Section 21 governs the legal effect of a Lok Adalat award.
sections.plain_language_summary: A Lok Adalat award is treated as a civil-court decree and has the finality stated by the Act.
